items.name: A passing harness self-check before the fence opens the cycle on a pinned source cut
items.rule: No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence

items.name: A harness self-check at goldens that are no longer current is refused
items.rule: No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence

items.name: A golden the harness self-check does not reproduce exactly fails it, by name
items.rule: No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence

items.name: A harness self-check before a gate attempt with no candidate for that attempt is refused
items.rule: No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence

items.name: A cycle with scores and no scoreboard golden cannot pass the harness self-check
items.rule: No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence

items.name: An instrument golden with no cycle beside it does not fail the harness self-check
items.rule: No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence

items.name: A scoring tool fenced out of the clean room is a listed skip, not a failure
items.rule: No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence

items.name: A clean room is proved when every check of the fence's probe holds, and the cycle moves to regenerate
items.rule: The fence proves the clean room; it never asserts it

items.name: No clean room is proved after a failed harness self-check
items.rule: The fence proves the clean room; it never asserts it

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing stops the fence
items.rule: The fence proves the clean room; it never asserts it

items.name: A clean room with two root commits is refused
items.rule: The fence proves the clean room; it never asserts it

items.name: A clean room whose history is more than one commit is refused
items.rule: The fence proves the clean room; it never asserts it

items.name: A fenced path left in the working tree is refused
items.rule: The fence proves the clean room; it never asserts it

items.name: A prior candidate reachable in the object graph is refused even when the working tree is clean
items.rule: The fence proves the clean room; it never asserts it

items.name: A clean room that keeps a scoring tool is refused
items.rule: The fence proves the clean room; it never asserts it

items.name: A fence with no fenced paths proves no clean room
items.rule: The fence proves the clean room; it never asserts it

items.name: A candidate that responded inside the boot budget passes, the margin is said out loud, and the cycle moves to the score
items.rule: The gate records one verdict per attempt, with the boot budget and its margin

items.name: A candidate that has not responded when the boot budget runs out fails the attempt, and the cycle goes back to regenerate
items.rule: The gate records one verdict per attempt, with the boot budget and its margin

items.name: The boot clock covers everything the launch entrypoint does, a build included
items.rule: The gate records one verdict per attempt, with the boot budget and its margin

items.name: No candidate is graded over a harness the self-check did not check
items.rule: The gate records one verdict per attempt, with the boot budget and its margin

items.name: The gate refuses to grade without the identity probe
items.rule: The gate records one verdict per attempt, with the boot budget and its margin

items.name: An identity probe that is not the one the self-check checked does not judge the candidate
items.rule: The gate records one verdict per attempt, with the boot budget and its margin

items.name: A failed harness self-check before the fence fails the cycle at the fence with no score
items.rule: A failed harness self-check fails the cycle, and a cycle failed before the score has no score

items.name: A failed harness self-check before a gate attempt fails the cycle at the gate and spends no attempt
items.rule: A failed harness self-check fails the cycle, and a cycle failed before the score has no score

items.name: No candidate is regenerated before the clean room is proved
items.rule: A candidate is regenerated for the next gate attempt, within the budget

items.name: The last gate attempt the budget allows fails, and the cycle fails without a score
items.rule: A cycle concludes once, passed after its scoreboard or failed at a named stage for a named reason

items.name: A refused fence fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: A cycle concludes once, passed after its scoreboard or failed at a named stage for a named reason

items.name: A golden whose scenario was reworded since it was written fails the harness self-check
items.rule: No clean room is built over an unchecked instrument: the harness self-check opens the cycle before the fence

items.name: The candidate of an attempt is installed in a fresh gate room
items.rule: The gate installs the regenerated candidate in a fresh gate room ORC chose

items.name: A cycle never has a fourth gate attempt
items.rule: The gate installs the regenerated candidate in a fresh gate room ORC chose

items.name: A replayed verdict records nothing and spends no attempt
items.rule: The gate records one verdict per attempt, with the boot budget and its margin

items.name: A seam that already responded before boot is not graded and spends no attempt
items.rule: The gate records one verdict per attempt, with the boot budget and its margin

items.name: The first candidate is a fresh generation for gate attempt 1, and a claim, not done
items.rule: A candidate is regenerated for the next gate attempt, within the budget

items.name: No candidate is regenerated beyond the budget's gate-attempt limit
items.rule: A candidate is regenerated for the next gate attempt, within the budget

items.name: Only a repair room mounts evidence, and only this cycle's gate evidence
items.rule: A candidate is regenerated for the next gate attempt, within the budget

items.name: A failed score stage fails the cycle at the score
items.rule: A cycle concludes once, passed after its scoreboard or failed at a named stage for a named reason

items.name: A cycle passes once its scoreboard is reported
items.rule: A cycle concludes once, passed after its scoreboard or failed at a named stage for a named reason

items.name: A filed measurement moves the cycle to the scoreboard and nothing else
items.rule: The instrument's facts only conclude the cycle, and never feed the build loop
